schema.profile: 2D UTC inline1or2XY, zero-momentum discharge+salinityDelta linearBC authoring; other source forms inspection-only
schema.one_target: add/set edits EXT only; forcing-create authors one fresh BC; separate consent each step
schema.selection: Exact source ID; BC Name matches source ID, not PLI label/support suffix
schema.geometry: Inspectinline/PLI; writeinline1or2XY only. PLI/z/momentum/other point counts are inspection-only. No coordinate conversion or successful native snap implied.
schema.units: Explicit discharge/constituent units; no density, chemical or vertical datum conversion
schema.absolute_vs_delta: Absolute keys remain inspection-only and are not authored. Never auto-aliased. Explicit remove_constituents + new salinityDelta is a reviewable correction, not a claim of physical equivalence.
schema.PLI: Preserved inventory and native REAPOL compatibility reported separately. #/semicolon header normalization never implied; unsupported serialization blocks authoring.
schema.edit_eligibility: WriteBC references to strict ordered linear discharge/salinityDelta timeseries withUTC coverage. EXT constants/realtime/constantBC/unknowns inspect only; candidate must pass complete profile before writing.
schema.preview_hash: Action, ID, request path+bytes, full supported graph byte hashes+identities, target, candidate EXT bytes, access controls
schema.text_validation: Decoded JSON keys/values and emitted identifier/name/unit/quantity/reference/scalar texts reject Unicode C* and Zl/Zp, unsafe INI delimiters and edge whitespace before staging. No normalization; printable international labels preserved.
schema.graph: Streamed mesh/ancillary content revalidated before atomic publication; no timestamps-only proof
schema.native: No engine or GUI execution, no hydraulic/salt response claim
